# cpanel_boxtrapper_settings (Resource)

Manages BoxTrapper status and configuration for an existing cPanel mail account. The account can be a complete mailbox address or the cPanel system username. The `enabled` status can always be managed. Changing any configuration attribute requires cPanel to report a non-null `from_name`, which Terraform preserves exactly; otherwise the provider refuses the change because cPanel would irreversibly replace null with an empty string. Removing the resource restores the managed settings observed when Terraform first took ownership and never deletes the mail account or queued messages.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cpanel_boxtrapper_settings" "support" {
  account = "support@example.com"
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account` (String) The existing mailbox address or cPanel system username.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether BoxTrapper is enabled for the account.

### Optional

- `enable_auto_whitelist` (Boolean) Whether BoxTrapper automatically allowlists addresses that the account contacts. When omitted on first creation, Terraform preserves the current cPanel value.
- `from_addresses` (String) The comma-separated sender addresses BoxTrapper associates with the account. When omitted on first creation, Terraform preserves the current cPanel value.
- `queue_days` (Number) The number of days BoxTrapper retains logs and queued messages. When omitted on first creation, Terraform preserves the current cPanel value.
- `spam_score` (Number) The SpamAssassin score at which BoxTrapper bypasses challenge verification. cPanel stores one decimal place. When omitted on first creation, Terraform preserves the current cPanel value.
- `whitelist_by_association` (Boolean) Whether BoxTrapper allowlists recipients associated with an allowlisted sender. When omitted on first creation, Terraform preserves the current cPanel value.

### Read-Only

- `from_name` (String) The optional sender name reported by cPanel. Terraform observes but does not manage this value. When it is null, Terraform can change only `enabled`; configuration changes are refused because cPanel would replace null with an empty string.
- `restore_enable_auto_whitelist` (Boolean) The automatic allowlist setting Terraform restores when the resource is removed.
- `restore_enabled` (Boolean) Whether BoxTrapper was enabled before Terraform management.
- `restore_from_addresses` (String) The sender address list Terraform restores when the resource is removed.
- `restore_queue_days` (Number) The queue retention period Terraform restores when the resource is removed.
- `restore_spam_score` (Number) The SpamAssassin score Terraform restores when the resource is removed.
- `restore_whitelist_by_association` (Boolean) The associated-recipient allowlist setting Terraform restores when the resource is removed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cpanel_boxtrapper_settings.support support@example.com
```
